'''MD-0''' was an [[MD-0 medical droid]] assigned to the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]]. Its service carried over once the ship's crew [[Mutiny on the Far Orbit|mutined]] and took over control of the vessel. MD-0 was responsible for seeing crew members reporting illness so that they could be diagnosed. MD-0 also assisted [[MD-5 (Far Orbit)|MD-5]] during physical examinations.<ref name="FOP" />
